Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.displayserver.nativewindow.x11

Class ReadbackPlanner

java.lang.Object
org.jdesktop.lg3d.displayserver.nativewindow.x11.ReadbackPlanner
public final class ReadbackPlanner extends Object
Chooses the pixel readback transport for a composited region and sizes the buffer it needs (Phase E: MIT-SHM fast path).

Reading through an attached MIT-SHM segment (X11ShmExt.getImage(gnu.x11.Drawable, int, int, int, int, int, int, int, int)) lets the server write the pixels straight into shared memory, avoiding a copy of the whole region through the X socket — the dominant cost for a video-playing or rapidly-repainting client. It is only usable when the extension is present, the server supports SHM pixmaps, and the region fits the attached segment; otherwise the planner falls back to a core XGetImage round-trip (Drawable.image(int, int, int, int, int, int)).

This class is a pure decision plus sizing arithmetic — no gnu.x11.Display, no segment lifecycle — so the path selection and the byte-size math are unit-testable headlessly. The live SHM attach/detach stays in the compositor.

    • bytesPerPixel

      public static int bytesPerPixel(int bitsPerPixel)
      The whole bytes per pixel for a bits-per-pixel value, rounding up. A non-positive depth is treated as the 32-bit default.
      Parameters:
      bitsPerPixel - the server's bits-per-pixel for the pixmap depth
      Returns:
      bytes per pixel, at least 1

    • regionBytes

      public static long regionBytes(int width, int height, int bitsPerPixel)
      The ZPixmap byte size of a width x height region at bitsPerPixel, ignoring scanline padding (a lower bound used to size/validate an SHM segment). Zero for a non-positive region.
      Parameters:
      width - region width in pixels
      height - region height in pixels
      bitsPerPixel - the server's bits-per-pixel for the pixmap depth
      Returns:
      the region size in bytes, or 0 if the region is empty

    • choose

      public static ReadbackPlanner.Path choose(boolean shmAvailable, boolean sharedPixmaps, long regionBytes, long shmSegmentCapacity)
      Chooses the readback path for one region.
      Parameters:
      shmAvailable - the MIT-SHM extension is present and a segment is attached for this window
      sharedPixmaps - the server supports SHM pixmaps (X11ShmExt.shared_pixmaps_supported)
      regionBytes - the region size in bytes (see regionBytes(int, int, int))
      shmSegmentCapacity - the attached segment's capacity in bytes; a value <= 0 means "unknown/unbounded"
      Returns:
      ReadbackPlanner.Path.SHM when the fast path is usable, else ReadbackPlanner.Path.XGETIMAGE
